title: A staged Causal Multiscale Consciousness Atlas study

research_brief.scientific_object: Distributed human brain dynamics supporting conscious perceptual experience, with a separately governed molecular module for testing an Orch-OR bridge.
research_brief.central_hypothesis: Conscious experience is supported by a dynamically integrated causal process with a measurable spatial and temporal extent; a joint perturbational, no-report, effective-connectivity, and complexity pattern will distinguish leading theory families better than any single biomarker.
falsification_conditions: candidate signature vanishes under report removal
perturbation changes report but not validated experience proxy
control perturbation reproduces the same causal pattern
held-out data do not support the pre-registered theory restriction
molecular signal lacks independent consciousness-linked timing or is explained by neural/network nulls

prohibited_actions: no TMS, anesthesia, sleep, EEG, MEG, fMRI, ECoG, or molecular experiment execution
no model training on human data
no claim of observed neural or quantum result

constructs.phenomenal_experience: pre-specified conscious perceptual content assessed through convergent report and validated indirect/no-report proxy
constructs.access: availability of stimulus information for flexible task use
constructs.report: verbal, button, confidence, or other explicit response channel
constructs.self_awareness: higher-order representation of one's own mental state, measured separately from basic sentience
constructs.state: global capacity or level of conscious processing
constructs.content: which experience is present under matched sensory conditions

stages.name: Construct validation and preregistration
stages.purpose: Freeze definitions, theory predictions, condition contrasts, no-report proxy validation, interventions, nuisance variables, and the analysis/hold-out plan before future data are viewed.
inputs: behavioral and physiological proxy validation plan
stages.gate: No confirmatory interpretation begins until experience, access, report, self-awareness, and state are separately operationalized.

stages.name: Report-matched and no-report content conditions
stages.purpose: Create conscious/unconscious or seen/unseen contrasts with matched sensory input and separate report demands from experience-sensitive proxies.
stages.gate: Advance only if the no-report proxy is independently calibrated and the report-matched contrast is not reducible to motor output, confidence, or attention.

stages.name: Multiscale recording and candidate localization
stages.purpose: Measure timing, spatial distribution, recurrence, long-range broadcasting, effective connectivity, and perturbational complexity at complementary scales.
inputs: approved noninvasive or clinically available recordings
stages.gate: No location claim is made from a passive association alone; candidate regions must proceed to D3 causal testing.

stages.name: Targeted causal perturbation
stages.purpose: Perturb candidate recurrent, broadcast, higher-order, or thalamocortical processes with sham and control targets while measuring both experience proxies and report variables.
stages.gate: Advance only when a candidate perturbation changes a validated experience-sensitive outcome beyond report/motor effects and differs from the control intervention.

stages.name: Theory-specific out-of-sample model comparison
stages.purpose: Compare GNW, IIT-inspired, recurrent, higher-order/predictive, and common-null dynamic models using frozen predictions, complexity penalties, and held-out participants/conditions.
stages.gate: A theory is not selected by fit alone; it must predict held-out condition, timing, topology, and intervention patterns better than the common null under the predeclared scoring rule.

stages.name: Independent Orch-OR molecular bridge stress test
stages.purpose: Test whether a specified microtubule-linked molecular/quantum observable has an independent, reproducible, time- and perturbation-linked relationship to the conscious-state manipulation.
inputs: approved ex vivo/in vitro or noninvasive strategy
stages.gate: A molecular observation cannot be labeled consciousness-generating unless it is consciousness-linked, independently measured, temporally predicted, and not explained by thermal, synaptic, network, or measurement artifacts.

theory_predictions.expected_pattern: long-range ignition and cross-system availability that survives no-report in a reduced form and predicts flexible access
perturbational differentiation/integration tracks conscious state and has a nontrivial causal topology
appropriately timed posterior feedback is sufficient for conscious content before later report-related activity
higher-order or precision-weighted dynamics add predictive power beyond sensory recurrence without collapsing into confidence/motor report
independent molecular signature with pre-specified timing and perturbation relationship to experience, beyond network/decoherence nulls

endpoints.primary: A causal evidence vector that identifies which candidate process changes validated experience-sensitive measures under report-matched/no-report conditions and predicts held-out data under theory-specific restrictions.
secondary: Orch-OR molecular bridge support or rejection code
endpoints.negative_results: A null result localizes a failed link: proxy validity, candidate location, causal necessity, theory prediction, or molecular bridge; no null is converted into a claim that consciousness is absent.

formal_analysis.causal_effect: tau_k=E[phi | do(u_k=1), c]-E[phi | do(u_k=0), c], where phi is a validated experience-sensitive proxy and c fixes the condition/controls
formal_analysis.theory_score: S_m=log p(D_holdout | M_m)-lambda C(M_m), with the same frozen scoring rule and complexity penalty for every theory model
formal_analysis.interpretation: F_theta, B_theta, and A_theta encode theory restrictions; u_t is the approved perturbation; y_t is the multiscale observation; eta_t and epsilon_t represent process and measurement noise; C(M_m) penalizes flexibility.

data_governance: separation of exploratory and confirmatory analyses
reproduction: independent sessions and participants where feasible
release of non-sensitive analysis specification when permitted

risks_and_human_review.risk: Report, attention, confidence, or motor activity masquerades as consciousness
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: no-report, report-matched, motor controls, independent proxy validation, and construct separation.

risks_and_human_review.risk: A state marker is mistaken for content or mechanism
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: separate state/content endpoints and require targeted causal perturbation.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Flexible models can fit any result
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: pre-registration, frozen restrictions, complexity penalties, and held-out prediction.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Orch-OR molecular signal is epiphenomenal or an artifact
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: independent measurement, time/scale prediction, synaptic/network/decoherence nulls, and explicit rejection code.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Human stimulation, sleep, anesthesia, or clinical recording risk
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: the present artifact executes none; future work requires qualified personnel, ethics approval, consent, safety monitoring, and local clinical/laboratory procedures.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Consciousness is inappropriately inferred in organoids or nonhuman systems
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: no organoid consciousness claim; any future model-system work must separately justify construct validity and ethics.
